jobs_results.title: Front-End Developer Experto en ReactJS y PostgreSQL con Inglés
jobs_results.description:
Funciones

Desarrollo de Interfaces de Usuario (UI): Utilizar ReactJS para crear componentes reutilizables y dinámicos que mejoren la experiencia de usuario. Integración con APIs: Conectar las interfaces de usuario construidas con ReactJS a servicios de back
• end, a menudo utilizando datos gestionados en PostgreSQL. Optimización de Rendimiento: Garantizar que las aplicaciones web sean rápidas y eficientes, implementando técnicas de optimización como la carga diferida de datos o componentes. Responsive Design: Asegurar que las aplicaciones web funcionen bien en una variedad de dispositivos y tamaños de pantalla. Manejo de Estado: Utilizar el estado y el contexto en ReactJS para manejar datos dinámicos y controlar la interacción del usuario. Seguridad de la Aplicación: Implementar prácticas de seguridad para proteger la información sensible del usuario.

Requisitos

Experiencia Profesional: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia trabajando como Front
• End Developer, con proyectos demostrables... que utilicen ReactJS. Dominio de ReactJS: Conocimiento profundo de ReactJS y su ecosistema, incluyendo hooks, context API, y manejo del estado. Experiencia con PostgreSQL: Capacidad para diseñar esquemas de bases de datos simples y realizar consultas eficientes, además de integrar estas bases de datos con aplicaciones front
• end. Desarrollo Web Moderno: Sólidos conocimientos en HTML5, CSS3, y JavaScript (ES6+), así como familiaridad con preprocesadores CSS como SASS o LESS. Responsive Design: Experiencia diseñando e implementando interfaces de usuario que sean responsivas y accesibles en una variedad de dispositivos y tamaños de pantalla. Integración de APIs: Habilidad para consumir y manejar datos de APIs RESTful o GraphQL. Control de Versiones: Proficiencia en el uso de herramientas de control de versiones, especialmente Git. Idiomas: español e ingles (proyectos y entrevistas)

Se ofrece

Salario Competitivo: Ofrecemos una banda salarial bruta anual de 32.000€ a 57.000€, dependiendo de tu experiencia y habilidades demostradas. Modalidad Freelance: Disfruta de la flexibilidad de trabajar como freelance, gestionando tu propio tiempo y proyectos. Trabajo Híbrido: Para fomentar tanto la colaboración como la flexibilidad, trabajarás 2 días a la semana desde nuestra oficina en Madrid y el resto desde la comodidad de tu hogar. Proyectos Innovadores: Trabaja en el desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas vanguardistas, utilizando las últimas tecnologías en ReactJS y PostgreSQL. Desarrollo Profesional: Comprometidos con tu crecimiento, ofrecemos oportunidades de formación continua y acceso a recursos para que estés siempre a la vanguardia tecnológica. Ambiente Colaborativo: Sé parte de un equipo inclusivo y colaborativo que valora las ideas y la participación activa en la creación de soluciones impactantes

jobs_results.title: Senior Front End Developer (React.js)
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete al equipo de BCNC Group como Desarrollador/a Senior Front End!

¿Eres un/a apasionado/a del desarrollo web y tienes amplia experiencia en tecnologías como React HTML CSS y JavaScript Typescript? ¡Entonces esta oportunidad es para ti!

En BCNC Group estamos en búsqueda de Desarrolladores/as Senior Front End con al menos 5 años de experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo remoto en una empresa multinacional del sector Retail para un proyecto de muy larga duración.

Requisitos

Amplio conocimiento en las tecnologías base de la web incluyendo React HTML CSS y JS.

Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de interfaces de usuario modernos.

Experiencia previa en desarrollo de aplicaciones web con React moderno tanto de componentes de clase como componentes funcionales dominio de uso y creación de hooks.

Imprescindible aportar experiencia con React Query.

Conocimiento del ecosistema React Redux webpack Router etc. así como de las herramientas generales de desarrollo como Eslint... prettier etc.

Experiencia en diseño e implementación de interfaces de usuario.

Conocimiento de las tecnologías en las que está basado React HTML CSS JS y ecosistema Accesibilidad HTML Semántico CSS modular BEM maquetación responsive ES6 PWAs etc...

Dominio de las técnicas de creación de interfaces adaptables a diferentes plataformas y tamaños de pantalla.

Experiencia con testing de aplicaciones de frontend Jest React Testing Library Cypress Mocha...

Experiencia en debugging perfilado y optimización de aplicaciones frontend usando las herramientas de desarrollo que proporcionan los diferentes navegadores.

Valorable

Experiencia con arquitectura hexagonal y conocimientos DDD.

Familiaridad con Figma.

Capacidad de entender un producto y aportar ideas para mejorar su usabilidad y funcionamiento general.

Experiencia con metodologías ágiles de desarrollo (SCRUM Kanban...).

Experiencia con TypeScript.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido.

Estabilidad laboral.

Trabajar en importantes proyectos con las tecnologías más punteras.

Posibilidad de realizar proyectos internacionales.

Desarrollo de carrera real y formación.

Disponibilidad para hacer guardias (Pasivas/activas).

Teletrabajo 100 .

BCNC GROUP es una empresa de ingeniería y tecnología con operaciones en España Reino Unido Alemania Francia y Suecia. Trabajamos con las multinacionales más prestigiosas de Europa ayudándoles a implementar sus proyectos estratégicos. ¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte de nuestro equipo innovador y dinámico!

Esperamos recibir tu candidatura pronto. ¡No pierdas esta oportunidad de crecimiento profesional!

typescript, javascript, react.js, jest, react testing library

jobs_results.title: Frontend Engineer (Remote, Spain based candidates ONLY)
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Frontend Engineer to join the team.

Remote candidates must be living (or willing to live) in: Spain.

Job description

As a Frontend Engineer, you will work together with our development team, product managers, and designers. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to build, to collaborate and to create value and direct impact to our users. We love to find team members that challenge and question the features they are working on.

Our Frontend is built with ReactJS. We use Figma to build our proprietary Design System and UI Kit. Our Backend runs on NodeJS and our platform on Google Cloud, it keeps us moving fast and scale up, but with strong resiliency.

What will you do?
• Work with an experienced development team and product managers to ideate, brainstorm and build impressive financial... features. Code hard, think hard.
• Design, develop and maintain our APIs and web applications for maximum robustness, scalability and security.
• Test all new features and enhancements to ensure responsiveness and efficiency. This includes mastering troubleshooting, debugging and upgrades. We also need you to document your code to make sure the team is fully aligned.
• Help us protect our users' data, confidentiality and integrity by creating security and data protection settings.
• Help build CI/CD, monitoring and testing practices together with the rest of the team.
• Work in a comfortable and rewarding environment, making sure that this company's culture and mission is safeguarded and spread.
• Be ready to develop skills and learn from other areas they might have expertise on.

What are we looking for?
• 5+ years of experience as a FullStack or Frontend engineer using Javascript/Typescript
• Experience in production environments using React is a must
• Strong knowledge of software architecture design patterns and coding best practices.
• You like taking responsibility, ownership and creating impact. We need builders and problem solvers who feel proud and liable for our success. Advocate a quality culture across the whole organization.
• You are comfortable with testing environments and make sure every detail is brushed before going to production. You are passionate about high quality.
• You are highly organized and can adjust priorities, having great attention to detail. You understanding the difference between perfect and a good-enough result
• Team player: "We" is always before "I". We need versatility, humility, and team members that enjoy working and learning from each other.
• You are ambitious: curious to learn about new tools and getting to the bottom of each problem
• Background studies related to Computer Science
• Languages: Working proficiency in English & fluent in Spanish
• Location: preferably in Madrid or elsewhere in Spain. If you don't live in Madrid, we will need you to come once a month for team meetings, team building... of course, we will cover the expenses.

Additionally, any of the below would definitely be great:
• Familiarity with the rest of our tech stack: React, Redux, Storybook, NodeJS, Express, Cypress, Jest, MongoDB, Python, GCP, Gitlab CI/CD…
• Experience with CI/CD processes and DevOps practices.
• Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools and quality monitoring.
• Previous experience in the financial industry or fintechs.
• International experience and additional languages are key to embracing our inclusive culture.
• We love people that are opinionated and are not afraid of disagreeing.
• Collaboration in open-source projects

What comes with working at this company?

We offer a platform that allows you to reach your professional and personal goals. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to lead, build, collaborate and create value to our users.

Additionally, also comes with the following benefits:
• A competitive salary according to the project and responsibility
• Hybrid working setup & flexible schedule
• Latest technology of your choice to do your impactful work with
• Access to private health insurance with Sanitas
• Access to salary on demand, restaurante card, transport card, and kindergarden checks through Payflow
• Career progression - we are a small team with great ambitions.
• An opportunity to work hand in hand with our founders who built their careers in Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan for more than a decade.
• Twice-yearly performance reviews
• 360º development - through internal and external talks, sponsored conferences and many more to come
• Fruit and coffee at the office!
• Team Buildings plans

Hiring Process

The process consists of 3 phases:
• 1st interview/call with Head of People
• 2nd technical interview with a couple of people from the team
• 3rd and last with the CTO

Joppy is a tech recruitment platform built for developers by developers.

✅ No CV required. Just say what you know and what you want.

✅ Anonymous profile by default.

✅ You choose who can talk to you. Companies can't write to you until you accept their offer.

✅ Only relevant offers matching your preferences. No more Javascript offers for Java developers.

✅ Get a reward if you get hired.

Keep an eye on tech job opportunities anonymously and match the job that makes you happy

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Estamos ampliando nuestros equipos de desarrollo, no nos importan mucho el título, pero a este rol le llamamos Frontend Developer y la clave es la experiencia en desarrollo de software con React, Angular o Vue, y constantes ganas de seguir aprendiendo.

Nuestra visión es construir equipos multidisciplinares, los cuales autogestionan directamente de forma AGILE los proyectos, para encontrar y realizar las mejores soluciones 😊

Requirements

¿Qué harás?
• Desarrollarás proyectos desde cero bajo supervisión mínima y con la colaboración del equipo
• Participarás en el diseño de arquitecturas y toma de decisiones en un entorno constructivo y con dinámica de cocreación.
• Trabajarás bajo conceptos SOLID
• Serás pieza clave en el desarrollo de buenas prácticas, código limpio y reusable

¿Qué buscamos?
• +3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software con React, Vue o Angular
• Muy valorable la experiencia en desarrollo en entornos .NET.
• Conocimiento y aplicación de patrones de diseño
•... Conocimiento en aplicación de CI/CD como parte indispensable del desarrollo de software
• Buena interacción y capacidad de trabajo con los diferentes equipos de las oficinas a nivel global
• Pasión por la tecnología y desarrollo de software
• Constantes ganas de aprender y habilidad para aprender rápidamente
• Team player
• INGLÉS - Muy valorable.

Benefits

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Salario acorde al mercado y tu experiencia 🤑
• Horario flexible 35 horas / semana 😎 (sin reducción de salario)
• Trabajo remoto 100% (opcional) 🌍
• Retribución flexible (restaurante, transporte y guardería) ✌
• Seguro médico y dental (totalmente gratuito para el empleado) 🚑
• Presupuesto individual para formación y certificaciones de Microsoft gratuitas 📚
• Clases de inglés (1 hora a la semana) 🗽
• Día libre por tu cumpleaños 🌴🥳
• Bonus mensual en concepto de electricidad e internet en casa 💻
• Descuento en plan de gimnasio y actividades deportivas 🔝
• Plain Camp (evento anual de team building) 🎪
• ➕ El gusto de trabajar siempre con las últimas herramientas tecnológicas

Con toda esta info ya conoces mucho de nosotros, ¿nos dejas que conozcamos más de ti?

¿El proceso de selección? - Sencillo, 3 pasos: una llamada y 2 entrevistas con el equipo 🤘

Y te preguntarás... ¿Quién es Plain Concepts?

Plain Concepts somos más de 400 personas apasionadas por la tecnología, movidas por el cambio hacia la búsqueda de las mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes y proyectos.

A lo largo de estos años, la empresa ha crecido gracias al gran potencial técnico que tenemos dentro y apoyándonos siempre en nuestras ideas más locas e innovadoras. Contamos con más de 14 oficinas en 6 países diferentes. Nuestro objetivo principal es seguir creciendo como equipo, realizando los mejores y más avanzados proyectos en el mercado.

Realmente creemos en la importancia de reunir personas de diferentes ámbitos y países para formar el mejor equipo, con una cultura plural e inclusiva.

¿Qué hacemos en Plain?

Nos caracterizamos por tener un ADN 100% técnico. Desarrollamos proyectos a medida desde 0, consultorías técnicas y formación.
• No hacemos bodyshopping ni outsorcing
• Nuestros equipos son multidisciplinares y la estructura de organización es plana y horizontal
• Muy comprometidos con los valores AGILE
• Vivir es compartir, nos ayudamos, apoyamos y animamos mutuamente para ampliar nuestros conocimientos internamente y también de cara a la comunidad (con conferencias, eventos, charlas...)
• Siempre buscamos la creatividad e innovación, incluso cuando la idea es una locura para otros
• La transparencia, clave para cualquier relación

Hacemos realidad las ideas y soluciones de nuestros clientes con un alto grado de excelencia técnica, para más información visita nuestra web:
• https://www.plainconcepts.com/es/casos-estudio/

En Plain Concepts, sin duda, buscamos ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades. Queremos solicitantes con diversidad sin importar la raza, color, género, religión, nacionalidad, ciudadanía, discapacidad, edad, orientación sexual o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley

jobs_results.title: Front End Engineer (React.JS)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

At CoverWallet we are determined to revolutionize the insurance industry! We launched in 2015 and since then we are the leading digital platform for contracting insurance for small and medium-sized companies. Thanks to state-of-the-art technology and meticulous design we have turned insurance management and processing into a simple, fast and convenient process for our clients. All online, in minutes!

Our passion is in delivering innovation and value creation through technology, and our mission is to become the world’s leading InsurTech. For this, we have built an incredible team of :800 people based in New York, Spain, Poland and Singapore. Success is guaranteed as we are part of Aon, the global leaders in risk, retirement and health solutions with 50,000 colleagues worldwide. We combine the mindset and culture of a high-growth startup with the backing and support of a global multinational. The best of both worlds in one company - what more could we ask for?

What You... Will Do

You will be part of our awesome Software Development Team that helps us with the Front End development of our multi-site platform, while being an operational enabler for the rest of the organization. As a Front End Engineer, you will be responsible for contribute to designing the architecture of our Front-end Coverwallet Products and participate in code reviews, identify and apply best practices for software development, as well as provide technical guidance and hands-on experience in software development. Mentor other junior engineers.

A TYPICAL DAY
• Planning and developing front-end features with your team.
• Working with the UX and Product teams in the Discovery process to develop world-class solutions.
• Working to improve UI performance, scalability, maintainability in a new product that is using a modern tech stack including Apollo GraphQL, React.js, Next.js, and Nest.js.
• Working with your teammates to define and implement architectural best practices.
• Working with your team to continuously improve processes so that we can focus our time on building great software and not dealing with interruptions, excessive planning meetings, etc.

What You Need To Succeed
• 3 to 5 years as a Front End Engineer working in infrastructure and software engineering environments
• From static design to Production running code
• Demonstrated UI design and UX sensibilities
• Responsive design, mobile-first
• JavaScript & React coder
• SEO techniques awareness
• Cross-browser compatibility issues knowledge, client-side performance
• Other JS libraries are a plus
• Strong Computer Science fundamentals
• Familiarity with MVC Ruby on Rails web framework or others
• Team player, really motivated with technical challenges
• Time management skills
• Open contributor, collaborator and team player
• Autonomous learner
• Proactive on taking ownership
• English proficiency is a must

About The Recruitment Process
• Your first contact with CoverWallet will be through an HR interview with one of our colleagues from the Talent Acquisition area, who will tell you everything about our company and its history, as well as the details of the position, functions and your future conditions. We would love to know your professional and academic career, and of course, your motivations and expectations for a new professional project. We will be happy to answer all your questions!
• Do we have a match? Let’s move on to your First Technical Interview! You will meet two of your future colleagues from the Software Development area, who will explain to you in more detail what the team's day-to-day life is and its responsibilities. They will be very interested in expanding information about their experience in the world of Front End technologies and your coding expertise.
• If everything has gone well and you have impressed our colleagues... we advance to the Second Technical Interview! In line with the previous one, you will meet two other members of the Software Development Team, who will continue to deepen your knowledge at the areas they could assess during the first interview.
• If you've made it this far, things are getting interesting... It's time for your Final Interview! In this case, you will have the opportunity to meet one of our VP of Engineering, who will close the selection process with an interview aimed at getting to know you not only on a professional and technical level, but also on a personal level, so that both of you can reach the conclusion of whether the purpose of our project fits with your professional aspirations.

WHY COVERWALLET

At CoverWallet you will have the opportunity to be a key player in the transformation of one of the largest industries and in one of the most developed digital markets in the world. You will work in a cutting-edge tech environment, alongside a super powerful and diverse global team. Join us and build your own career plan in one of the world's leading companies, tailored to your dreams and aspirations! And just for good measure…
• Competitive salary based on your background and experience, and a variable annual bonus set according to your goals
• Enjoy flexible working hours and find out your ideal way of working thanks to our smart work model: full remote or hybrid, it’s up to you!
• Perks package consisting of a Company-paid Life, Accident Insurance and Medical Cover with free dental care. Complement your benefits with our flexible compensation plan (tickets restaurant, transport card, daycare checks, external training and even a Pension Scheme!)
• Carry on with your training thanks to your additional budget of 1,500€ per year to finance training courses, certifications, books or any teaching aids that will help you continue to grow professionally
• Enjoy a lot of offers and save on your purchases thanks to our discount platform (BigPocket) on your favorite brands (travel, fashion, technology, leisure...)
• 23 paid vacation days per year, plus 2 additional personal days and 2 wellbeing days to focus on your own health and prioritize self-care :)
• Great offices in Madrid, Valencia and Sevilla, where you will find all the coffee, drinks, snacks and fruit you want. Come and enjoy all the activities we do, both inside and outside the office (hackathons, meetups, tech talks, code katas and much more!)

2539422

Desarrollo web, escritorio y mobile de la aplicación

• ¡Tercer viernes de cada mes libre!
• Flexibilidad en horario.
• 23 días de vacaciones laborales.
• Día del cumpleaños libre
• Flexibilidad en las herramientas de trabajo: Sistema operativo, IDE, etc…
• Trabaja desde donde quieras sin problemas. Trabajamos siempre full-remote, aunque tenemos oficinas en Madrid a las que podrías ir si así lo prefieres.
• 100€/mes aparte en concepto de teletrabajo.
• Días libres para asistencia a eventos de interés tales como Codemotion, LechazoConf y DevFest.
• Formación: Selección de cursos en plataformas como Udemy o CodelyTV.

• Llamada telefónica
• Prueba técnica
• Entrevista

• Que haya desarrollado Progressive web apps.
• Que haya hecho tests unitarios y end-to-end.
• Que esté familiarizado con entornos de integración continua y metodología SCRUM.
• Una persona autónoma y proactiva, que pueda resolver los problemas por sí mismo.

• Que trabaje en proyectos OpenSource y comparta código en plataformas como Github.
• Suela asistir a eventos relacionados con la programación.
• Forme parte de comunidades y grupos locales

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Angular)
jobs_results.description:
About Gelato

Gelato has built the world's largest and most global platform for on-demand production and fulfillment of customized products. Today, those products are part of huge markets, such as apparel, wall art, drinkware, digitally printed books, and greeting cards. In the future, the market opportunities are endless thanks to new technologies such as 3D printing. We support a new wave of e-commerce entrepreneurs to sell their creativity globally, with a more local and sustainable production. With local production and exact matching of supply and demand, there is no waste, and carbon emissions are reduced. We support a new wave of e-commerce entrepreneurs and the global shift towards local and more sustainable production.

We own no assets - we build the software that connects world-class production facilities all across the world. We have more than 100 production partners in 32 countries. In 72 hours we can reach more than 5 billion people with customized products in a smarter... faster, and greener way.

Gelato Technology

We own no physical production assets, or servers, instead, our asset is a cloud-based connectivity platform that enables world-class on-demand production for e-commerce platforms and applications. This engineered platform needs to provide our customers access to more than 130 production partners in 32 countries and includes production plate design, routing to an appropriate partner, and finally linking to logistics systems for delivery to the consumer. All this in 72 hours and reaching more than 5 billion people and potential consumers in a smarter, faster, and greener way.

The employed technologies range from backends using PHP and GoLang to mobile apps built natively or with hybrid technology such as Flutter or ReactNative, running on cloud services and with a modern CI/CD pipeline. Designing highly-available, fault-tolerant, cost-effective, scalable systems is our passion. We are using BDD principles and patterns, and agile methodology. Designing public API for millions of people, integrating with world-class third-party systems, and solving complex engineering problems (Graph, CAP, etc) are only a small glimpse into the tasks.

What you will be doing
• Use the latest technologies to improve and streamline user interfaces across our products.
• Collaborate closely with other engineers, and architects as a valuable member of a cross-functional team
• Share your knowledge and build creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices
• Working closely with our UI/UX designers and product managers to realize the vision
• Take end-to-end responsibility for the services that are owned by your team, including taking part in an on-call rotation, quality, and reliability.

Who you are
• A minimum of B.S. degree in Information Technology or Computer Science or 5+ years in a similar position.
• Ability to adapt, change, and grow quickly as we scale the organization
• Passionate about engineering practices like agile, continuous delivery, test-driven development, traceability and observability
• Minimum 5 years of experience in writing excellent code (JavaScript, TypeScript); all standards-compliant, cross-browser, and cross-device.
• Strong experience with Angular and/or React and willingness and interest in learning not only more about both Angular and React, but also other promising frameworks.
• Good understanding of building shared UI components and test-driven development. Plus a sharp eye for design and UX details.
• You share your ideas and continuously improve yourself and the team around you
• Strong communication skills, high integrity, and great attention to detail.
• Experience with MongoDB will be a plus.

You’ll get to work with:
• Angular / NodeJS (NestJS)
• GraphQL
• MongoDB
• ELK / Datadog / Prometheus / Grafana / Sentry
• Microservices architecture
• Cypress / Cucumber.js
• CircleCI / ArgoCD

What it’s like to work at Gelato

We are a customer-obsessed team with the ambition to change the world by connecting technology to the printing industry and making it much more sustainable. Everyone who joins our team must feel genuinely intrigued and motivated by our mission. We expect a lot. We are a driven team with big goals, so we seek individuals who are genuinely passionate about their work and possess an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is unique, and we live by our values, so it's worth learning more about our culture and how we work before presenting your application.

At Gelato, we pride ourselves on our global presence with 16 offices worldwide, fostering a dynamic and diverse work environment. Rooted in a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and camaraderie, we actively cultivate a company culture that thrives on shared experiences. We encourage team members to embrace this culture by working from our inspiring office spaces at least three days a week, allowing for meaningful connections and collective growth.

Lastly, we ask that you please upload your CV in English, regardless of which country you are applying from

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer Hubspot
jobs_results.description:
Se encargará del desarrollo de las campañas y en paralelo dará apoyo al resto del equipo de front-end.

Este perfil estará en constante comunicación con el equipo de diseño por lo que se valorará positivamente, además de su experiencia como maquetador de sitios web, su orientación hacia el diseño, pudiendo aportar valor a las soluciones propuestas por este equipo. El candidato, además de tener los conocimientos que se listan a continuación en desarrollo frontend, tiene que tener inquietudes en aprender y trabajar con herramientas de terceros: Hubspot, WebFlow...

Requisitos:

Experiencia profesional requerida:

Más de 3 años de experiencia como desarrollador frontend, es imprescindible tener alta experiencia probada en CMS de Hubspot.

Experiencia en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban,…).

Se valorará:

Conocimiento de email testing (Litmus o Email Acid preferiblemente) muy valorable.

Conocimiento de Webflow muy valorable.

Conocimiento de Figma o Sketch.

El desarrollo de... microservicios y servicios serverless para integraciones con la API de Hubspot y servicios personalizados con API de terceros.

Requisitos indispensables:

HTML5 CSS3/CSS inline.

Maquetación responsive en e mails y sitios web.

Conocimiento de las limitaciones HTML y CSS en los diferentes clientes de correo.

Manejar estos lenguajes que admite HubSpot:

Operations Hub: Phyton, JavaScript (Node.js), Java, C#

CMS Hub: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HubL (lenguaje específico de HubSpot para desarrollar plantillas y módulos: https://developers.hubspot.es/docs/cms/hubl)

Nivel alto de inglés (C1).

Formación Académica:

Estudios mínimos: Grado universitario, Ingeniero en Informática, Telecomunicaciones o equivalente.

Se valorarán las certificaciones AGILE, PMP...

Competencias personales:

Capacidad de análisis y toma de requisitos de funcionales.

Soporte e interlocución al equipo de PMO.

Orientación al servicio.

Capacidad de investigación.

Capacidad de adaptación /flexibilidad
